Package midtermlabproject2

Class PostfixEvaluator

java.lang.Object
midtermlabproject2.PostfixEvaluator
public class PostfixEvaluator extends Object
Evaluates a space-separated postfix expression using a LinkedStack of operands (Module 3).

Operands must be numbers (optionally negative or decimal). Supported operators are + - * / ^, where ^ is exponentiation. Each step is recorded as a Row so the trace table can be printed with TablePrinter.

Example: 6 2 3 + - 3 8 2 / + * 2 ^ 3 + evaluates to 52.

    • evaluate

      public double evaluate(String postfix) throws InvalidExpressionException
      Evaluates a postfix expression. The trace table is available afterwards through getRows(); any rows from a previous call are discarded.
      Parameters:
      postfix - the postfix expression, with tokens separated by spaces
      Returns:
      the numeric value of the expression
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if the expression is empty, contains a token that is neither a number nor an operator, has an operator without two operands, leaves more than one value on the stack, divides by zero, or produces a result that is not a valid number

    • apply

      private double apply(char op, double a, double b) throws InvalidExpressionException
      Applies a binary operator to two operands.
      Parameters:
      op - the operator: one of + - * / ^
      a - the left operand (operand1)
      b - the right operand (operand2)
      Returns:
      the result of a op b
      Throws:
      InvalidExpressionException - if dividing by zero, if the operator is unknown, or if the result is NaN or infinite
